# How to make an AI virtual try-on video from a flat-lay clothing photo

**Turn a flat-lay photo of clothing into a model wearing it and fit-check clips (turn, walk, mirror selfie) with the garment kept intact.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-tryon-video`: ~$0.04 per try-on still, ~$0.79 per 5 s Kling 4 clip (tested). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay.

<p><a href="../../varg-tryon-video/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_b7847d18f90a.webp" alt="A model in a cream striped cardigan, white tee and light jeans does a fit-check turn in a bright bedroom." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`varg-tryon-video`](../../varg-tryon-video/README.md): clean the garment photo, dress the model (Bria Virtual Try-On or an edit), animate fit-check motions, honest size captions. The other 3 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-tryon-video --skill varg-character-design --skill product-photo-to-video --skill ai-ad-compliance-check
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Put this cardigan ./cardigan.jpg on a model and make a 15-second fit-check video: slow turn, tug and let fall, mirror selfie."*

## FAQ

### Can AI put my clothes on a model?

Yes. varg-tryon-video dresses a model photo with Bria Virtual Try-On in one call (4 credits in the skill's test), or with a Nano Banana or GPT Image edit for harder garments, then keeps the same model across shots.

### What photos do I need?

A flat-lay or ghost-mannequin photo of 1000 px or more with tags and measurement labels removed, and a full-body model photo (generated, or a consenting real person).

### Will prints, logos and buttons survive?

Bria can soften prints, logos and embroidery; then the skill uses nano_banana_2_1 or gpt_image_2_5 with both images and an instruction to preserve every visible print and seam. In the test, stripes and buttons held but two patch pockets were dropped.

### How is the try-on animated?

Fit-check motions that sell clothes (slow turn, tug and let fall, walk to camera, mirror selfie, fabric close-up) on Kling 4 (79 credits per 5 s at 720p in the test) or Seedance 2.5 with the garment as a reference.

### Do I have to label an AI model?

Yes: an AI label on TikTok and Meta, and in ads reaching New York a visible synthetic-performer disclosure. Never use a real person's likeness without consent.
